annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of different datasets with their respective proportions. There are five slices in total. The slices are labeled as follows: "TriviaQA", colored red, accounting for approximately 46% (1,829); "WebQA", colored purple, comprising about 25% (997); "HalluEval", colored green, making up roughly 18% (721); "Chinese Domain", colored yellow, constituting around 6% (231); and "HalluQA", colored light blue, representing approximately 5% (185). A legend is not present, but the percentage labels and numbers are displayed next to each slice. The slices appear to be emphasized in 3D with no particular ordering observed.
